description:
Welcome to The 9th Charnel, the first-person psychological survival horror that will keep you on the edge of your seat! Dive into an oppressive futuristic world where a team of scientists is trapped in a remote facility. Occult rituals, failed experiments, and a supernatural presence have turned reality into a living nightmare. Manage limited resources, explore dark corridors, alternate between tense stealth, combat, and narrative exploration. Uncover the truth behind the ninth charnel in this atmospheric experience with a unique psychological twist. No cheap jump scares, just pure tension and decisions that matter.
